items.title: Rasheer Fleming helped pack & deliver chemo kits to Banner MD Anderson Cancer Center. In partnership with the Phoenix Suns/Phoenix Mercury Foundation and Chemo Companions, these kits will provide comfort, encouragement and support to patients throughout treatment.
